_doc: Variable registry - the single home of every value a project must define before/while the verification flow runs.
Read by new_project.py (detect/scan/status/set/apply/check) and by the interviews of the /new-project and /new-verification skills.
A new value the user must define is registered here in the same change (arch_memory R7), with its stage.
stage: 'project' = asked by /new-project (framework migration, once per chip); 'verification' = asked by /new-verification (per verification effort).
phase: interview order inside the stage (project P1 identity+design root, P2 machine tools, P3 VCS server, P4 language;
verification V1 inputs, V2 config top level, V3 register table, V4 design sources, V5 gate level).
Paths in 'file'/'files' are relative to verify/. Values that are paths are repo-root relative or absolute.
kind decides how apply writes the value:
json_field     top-level key of a JSON file ('key'); 'type' bool|str
sh_var         VAR="value" line in a shell file; with 'repo_path' a relative value is written as $database_path/<value>
text_file      whole file rendered from 'template' ({v} = value)
filelist_block lines between the 'start' and 'end' marker comments, one per list item, rendered from 'line':
{p} = the item as a filelist path (repo-relative -> ../../../<item>, absolute kept); items may carry a
'-f ' / '-v ' / '-y ' prefix. Missing markers are appended to the file (WARN) before writing.
choice_rewrite per-choice literal snippets ('snippets': {file: {choice: text}}) swapped in the listed files
record_only    kept in answers.json only (read by tools, reports and later stages)
detect_only    never written; check verifies it on this machine (machine-level values, CLAUDE.md rule)
owner: another writer owns the target (e.g. spec2json writes the config) - apply skips it, check only compares.
rewrites: [{files, pattern}] - after apply, pattern with the previously applied value is replaced by the new value.
default may reference another answer as {design_root}.
detect: probe used for candidates; 'scan:<id>' takes the suggestion of `new_project.py scan`.
residue (choice vars): per choice, phrases that must not remain in the residue_files once that choice is applied - check reports each hit as a WARN with file:line.

vars.prompt: Chip/project name (lower-case identifier). Names the system top tb_top_<name>.sv and its filelist. Also the project id: written as `define PID <name> into script/sflow/project_name (deployed as sim/project_name; compiled by both flows).
Root of the design database (RTL, IP, netlists, register table): repo-root relative or absolute. The repo's hdl/ is only a placeholder.
UVM-1.2 library for the oEDA flow (environment variable UVM_HOME, default $HOME/tools/uvm-1.2).
Verilator on PATH for the oEDA flow (OSS CAD Suite environment sourced).
Synopsys VCS on PATH (VCS sign-off flow).
VERDI_HOME (FSDB dump / Verdi GUI).
Python 3 (with openpyxl) used by RalGen, testjson2lst and the Makefile seed.
Dispatch simulations through LSF (bsub)? FALSE runs every case on the local host.
Default LSF queue (also the pattern used to discover sibling queues in the hosts file).
LSF cluster hosts file (lsb.hosts) read for queue/host slot discovery.
Host-name fragments (3rd '-'-separated field of $HOST) allowed to submit to LSF, space separated; empty = any host.
Extended regex matching execution-host names in the hosts file.
sed expression mapping a host-group name in the hosts file to its LSF queue name ('s/x/x/' = identity).
DPO learn/apply/reference database root (only used with -dpo).
Max concurrent wsim (VCS) invocations the agents may start, all agents together (ops section 3; license and LSF budget).
Language of conversational output (replies, reports, questions) of the leader and every agent.
Language of every file written into the project (docs, memories, reports, commit messages).
Directory with the architecture/design/verification-plan documents (repo-root relative or absolute). 'none' = pre-research mode on reference RTL (RTL readable without approval).
Directory scanned for the design sources of this verification effort (inside the design root).
Does the chip have a register model (config top-level enable_ral)? false forces every module enable_ral=false and adapter_type="".
Generate the top-level interface config (env/top_if.sv + top_if_pc.sv)?
Register-table CSV consumed by RalGen (needs the RegName/FieldName/OffsetAddr/EndAddr/BitEnd columns). Asked only when enable_ral is true.
Design RTL sources in compile order (packages first), or '-f <design filelist>' entries.
Design include directories (those holding headers the RTL `includes).
IP model sources (vendor/encrypted/third-party).
Design macro files (only `define/`ifdef content), compiled before the RTL.
Design top module(s) - used for the RTL lint and when tb_top instantiates the DUT.
Gate-level netlist sources (usually deferred until synthesis delivers).
Gate-level IP netlists/models.
Standard-cell / foundry Verilog libraries for gate-level simulation ('-v <lib>' entries allowed).
Libraries for gate/post-layout simulation (-l gate|post).
